source.title: Fable 5.1 Solves the Cyphral Distich, a 370-year-old cipher
source.author: u1hcw9nx

title.en: AI Solves the Cyphral Distich Cipher

excerpt.zh: Cyphral Distich密码沉寂近370年后，Claude Fable 5.1找到书内索引线索；结果与历史语境吻合，但部分长密码仍待实物核验。
excerpt.en: The Cyphral Distich cipher yields to Claude Fable 5.1 through a book-based clue, while parts of the larger cipher still need physical verification.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Cyphral Distich密码的意外突破
text.en: The Cyphral Distich Breakthrough

text.zh: Cyphral Distich密码是一组出现在托马斯·厄克特《Logopandecteision》末尾的数字密码，长期被视为未解的历史谜题。Vals称，Claude Fable 5.1在一次开放式任务中用不到一天找到了解法，但这一结论仍应与原始书页及独立复核区分开来。
text.en: The Cyphral Distich cipher is a numerical puzzle found at the end of Thomas Urquhart’s Logopandecteision, where it remained unresolved for centuries. Vals reports that Claude Fable 5.1 found a solution during an open-ended task in less than a day, although that claim should still be distinguished from independent checking against the original pages.

text.zh: 密码由两行组成，每行32个数字。此前的尝试多集中在频率分析、替换密码或同音替换，却没有找到稳定结果。关键并非建立一套外部字母表，而是注意到密码紧接着书中的32篇“Proquiritations”，同时配诗又提到读者将发现自己的愿望和作者的心意。
text.en: The puzzle contains two lines of 32 numbers. Earlier efforts focused on frequency analysis, substitution, or homophonic substitution, without producing a convincing result. The decisive insight was not an external cipher alphabet, but the fact that the numbers follow Urquhart’s 32 “Proquiritations,” while the accompanying poem refers to a reader finding wishes and the author’s mind.

text.zh: 书本本身就是密钥
text.en: The Book Becomes the Key

text.zh: 解法规则相当直接：对每一行的第i个数字，进入第i篇Proquiritation，把该数字作为词序号，再取对应单词的首字母。按此方法得到的文本是向查理二世祈祷的两行文字，内容请求上帝扶持国王并使其统治这片土地。两行各含32个字母，并以押韵的“and”“land”收尾，形成自我验证。
text.en: The rule is comparatively simple: for the i-th number in a line, go to the i-th Proquiritation, use the number as a word index, and take the first letter of that word. The resulting two-line text is a prayer asking God to uphold King Charles II and make him ruler of the land. Each line has 32 letters and ends with the rhyming words “and” and “land,” providing an internal check.

text.zh: 这一结果也符合厄克特的政治立场，因此比任意可读的明文更有说服力。更重要的是，模型并未依赖复杂的密码学突破；它先筛选较可能验证的问题，再持续尝试，最终识别出数字数量、段落数量和“愿望”提示之间的联系。
text.en: The result also fits Urquhart’s known Royalist politics, making it more persuasive than an arbitrary readable phrase. The reported achievement was not a dramatic advance in cryptanalysis. The model first selected a problem that appeared verifiable and tractable, then kept testing ideas until it connected the number of entries, the structure of the book, and the clue about wishes.

text.zh: 更长密码的进展与限制
text.en: The Larger Cipher and Its Limits

text.zh: 同一报告还称，Fable 5.1用类似方法处理了《The Jewel》中的Cyphral Octastich：连续数字对应连续页码，再以数字定位单词并读取首字母。大部分位置能够形成连贯的保王派祈祷，但仍有九个字母难以解释，另有页码偏移和转录问题。
text.en: The report also says that Fable 5.1 applied a related method to the Cyphral Octastich in The Jewel. The numbers are read across successive pages, with each number selecting a word whose first letter is extracted. Most positions produce a coherent Royalist prayer, but nine letters remain unclear, alongside page offsets and transcription problems.

text.zh: 因此，“破解”需要分层理解：较短的Cyphral Distich有清晰规则、完整文本和历史语境支持；较长的密码仍是部分重建。报告指出，确认那些偏移位置和疑难字母需要1652年版本的实物，或可靠的现代校订本。没有这些材料，任何完整宣称都应保留谨慎。
text.en: The word “solved” therefore needs qualification. The shorter Cyphral Distich has a clear rule, a complete-looking plaintext, and historical support; the longer cipher is still only partly reconstructed. The report notes that resolving the offsets and uncertain letters requires a physical copy of the 1652 edition or a dependable modern edition. Without that evidence, claims of a fully settled reading should remain cautious.

text.zh: AI对历史谜题的实际意义
text.en: What This Means for AI Research

text.zh: 这项案例的意义可能不在于模型发明了新的密码算法，而在于它能投入大量注意力阅读冷门材料、追踪线索并放弃不合适的问题。许多档案谜题的瓶颈并非原则上不可解，而是缺少愿意反复查找、比较和验证的人力。AI可以降低这类探索的时间成本，但仍需要人类提供文本校勘、来源判断和历史解释。
text.en: The significance may lie less in inventing a new cryptographic algorithm than in sustaining attention across obscure material, tracing clues, and abandoning unsuitable problems. Many archival puzzles may be constrained less by fundamental impossibility than by the limited human time available for searching, comparing, and testing. AI can reduce that exploration cost, but people still need to handle textual criticism, source evaluation, and historical interpretation.

text.zh: 目前最稳妥的结论是：Vals报告为Cyphral Distich提供了一个简洁且高度自洽的解法，也展示了模型在历史研究中进行长程探索的潜力；但报告本身不是独立认证。后续研究应公布可重复的逐项索引、核对原版页面，并明确哪些字母来自原文、哪些来自转录或推断。
text.en: The most defensible conclusion is that the Vals report presents a simple and highly self-consistent solution for the Cyphral Distich, while illustrating AI’s potential for sustained historical investigation. The report itself is not independent certification. Further work should publish reproducible word-by-word indexes, compare them with original page images, and distinguish letters supported by the source from those introduced by transcription or inference.
